channel.title: appstore-spec
channel.description: Documentation for the HAX appstore specification: external media providers, upload targets, reusable stax templates, and autoloaded elements for the HAX editor.

item.title: Overview
item.description: appstore-spec documents the HAX appstore specification: the schema that defines external media providers, upload targets, reusable stax templates, and autoloaded elements for the HAX editor. An appstore payload is typically returned by a backend endpoint (for example generateAppStore ) or loaded from a static JSON file. HAX reads these keys at the top level via HaxStore._loadAppStoreData in webcomponents elements/hax-body/lib/hax-store.js . A payload wrapped in { "data": { ... } } is ignored....

item.title: Apps & Connections
item.description: Each item in apps is a provider definition with a details block (display information) and a connection block (how HAX talks to the provider). details fields title — provider display label. icon — icon used in the HAX UI. color — accent color for the provider card. author — provider owner / source. description — short description shown in the UI. status — provider state (commonly available ). tags — searchable categorization terms. tos — optional terms / policy links. connection fields protoco...

item.title: Operations
item.description: Operations define how HAX talks to a provider. Each app's connection.operations object supports a required browse operation and an optional add operation. Common operation fields method — HTTP method ( GET , POST , etc). endPoint — path appended to connection.url after a / (no leading slash). data — request query values, merged over connection.data . resultMap — path mappings from the provider response into HAX preview/gizmo data. Browse-only fields search — search inputs. Only the first key ...

item.title: resultMap & Special Values
item.description: resultMap maps upstream API response data into HAX item previews and final gizmo values. resultMap fields items — dot path to the array of result records. If it doesn't resolve, the whole response is used as the array. preview — fields shown in result cards: title , details (HTML stripped) and id are required; image is optional, with resultMap.image as a fixed fallback. gizmo — target value to dot path mappings. These become the inserted element's properties via guessGizmo . defaultGizmoType ...

item.title: Stax & Autoloader
item.description: Stax stax is an array of named content stacks (HAX elements) users can insert as reusable patterns. { "details": { "title": "Two column Article", "author": "HAXTheWeb core team", "description": "Content with media to right", "status": "available", "tags": ["media"] }, "stax": [ { "tag": "grid-plate", "properties": { "layout": "2-1" }, "content": "<p slot=\"col-1\">Example text</p><media-image slot=\"col-2\" source=\"https://example.org/image.jpg\"></media-image>" } ] }...

item.title: More Schemas
item.description: appstore-spec is one of several schema specifications in the HAX ecosystem. Explore the others: JSON Outline Schema — the content structure, site navigation, and metadata schema used by HAXcms. HAX Schema — the full haxProperties contract for element authoring. HAX Element Schema — the lightweight virtual DOM object format used for demoSchema, insertion, and conversion workflows.
